prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one square fictional landscape photograph for a clearly marked home-dashboard demo photo album. Leave a generous clear pale-blue sky in the upper third so that a clock overlay will be readable; keep the main mountains below that space. Soft warm morning daylight, real water reflections, subtle grass and stone texture, everyday travel-photography feeling rather than fantasy or illustration. Independently generated, no reference photograph. Opaque background.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one square fictional portrait photograph for a clearly marked home-dashboard demo photo album. Waist-up framing, relaxed natural arms and hands near her waist, gentle expression, realistic age lines, skin texture and fabric. Her head begins just below the upper quarter and her body occupies the middle/lower frame; keep quiet wall space above her for a clock overlay. Soft garden foliage may appear near the lower edges. Natural warm daylight, believable anatomy, travel-album photography, not fashion retouching or illustration. This is a fictional person, not a likeness of any known or supplied person; no reference photo. No jewelry with logos, brands, readable text, timestamps, UI, borders or watermark. Opaque background.
